## Objective
- Replace the existing game with a complete, playable 2D Zelda-style dungeon featuring fire puzzles.

## Requirements
- Build it now; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions have been made yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the existing Vite/Three.js game and its main files.

### Active
- Build the requested dungeon game; the repository currently contains an unrelated 3D arena fighting game.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Replace or adapt the current game into a playable 2D Zelda-style dungeon with fire puzzles.
2. Run the production build and report the assumptions briefly.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Current game UI and page entry point.
- `src/main.js`: Existing game setup, controls, loop, and gameplay.
- `src/arena.js`: Existing Three.js arena.
- `src/style.css`: Existing UI styling.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- No files have been changed; no build or gameplay verification has been performed.

## Objective
- Replace the existing game with a complete, playable 2D Zelda-style dungeon featuring fire puzzles.

## Requirements
- Build it now; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the existing Vite/Three.js arena game and its main files.

### Active
- Build the requested dungeon game in place of the unrelated 3D arena fighting game.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Replace or adapt the current game into a playable 2D Zelda-style dungeon with fire puzzles.
2. Run the production build and report the assumptions briefly.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Current game UI and page entry point.
- `src/main.js`: Existing game setup, controls, loop, and gameplay.
- `src/arena.js`: Existing Three.js arena.
- `src/style.css`: Existing UI styling.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- No files have been changed; no build or gameplay verification has been performed.

## Objective
- Replace the existing game with a complete, playable 2D Zelda-style dungeon featuring fire puzzles.

## Requirements
- Build it now; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

## Decisions
- Top-down pixel-art dungeon adventure: find a key, light three braziers, and open the exit.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` has Emberfall dungeon UI, HUD, controls, and intro/end overlays.
- Replaced `src/main.js` with canvas-based dungeon gameplay, movement, fireballs, braziers, key, bats, health, and exit logic.

### Active
- Replace arena styling with responsive dungeon-game styling in `src/style.css`.
- Run the production build and verify gameplay.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Replace `src/style.css` with styling matching the existing Emberfall markup.
2. Run the production build and address any errors.
3. Briefly report assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Emberfall game UI and module entry point.
- `src/main.js`: New dungeon gameplay and rendering.
- `src/style.css`: Still has the previous arena styling; needs replacement.
- `package.json`: Vite build scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; earlier `git status --short` showed `M index.html`, and `src/main.js` was subsequently replaced.
- No build or gameplay verification has been performed.
